description: The Survival Cycle: Forensic resilience-scan matrix mapping Victorian water survival.
methodology: Quadrant Modeling: Developed a bi-variant resilience scan mapping 'Reservoir Health' (Average Storage %) against 'Engineering Injection' (Desalination Orders). Axis Centering: Implemented a centered-crosshair layout at the mathematical thresholds of 70% Storage and 75 GL Injection to define four operational zones: Safe Zone, Critical Stress, Engineered Survival, and Artificial Recharge. Trajectory Scan: Engineered a connected temporal path to visualize the state's physical migration across quadrants. Circular Finish: Implemented a post-2021 toggle to reveal the state's physical loop back to safety in the 2023-2025 era.
citation: Melbourne Water. (2026). Historical Reservoir Levels & Desalination Orders. Spatially and temporally harmonized for resilience scanning by D. Sharma (2026).
